source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Note 7 Income Taxes, cash paid for income taxes
source.quote: TOTAL CASH PAID FOR INCOME TAXES $ 1,270 [USD millions, fiscal 2026]

notes: Fiscal year ended May 31, 2026. Taxes: cash paid for income taxes, net of refunds received (us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet), from the by-jurisdiction table in Note 7 (ASU 2023-09); it includes $268 million for the final transition-tax installment and $260 million of estimated payments toward an expected IRS resolution for fiscal 2017-2019. R&D not reported as a separate line in the FY2026 10-K.
